name: launch-codes
description: Risky commands need launch codes: a red alert pane, a 4-character code to arm, and a LAUNCH to fire. Guards Bash and PowerShell, and edits to .env files. Adapted from OneWave AI's launch-codes (MIT).

protectEnv.title: Guard .env files
protectEnv.description: Edits and writes to .env files (not .env.example) also need launch codes

codeSeconds.title: Code lifetime (seconds)
codeSeconds.description: How long a launch code stays valid before it expires
